description: A service class in an Angular project providing utility functions for widget management, error handling, translation, color generation, telemetry subscription, and DOM manipulation within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: UtilsService
classes.description: An Angular service providing utility functions for widget management, error handling, translation, telemetry, and DOM manipulation within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: getPredefinedFunctionsList
methods.description: Returns the list of predefined function names available in the service.

methods.name: getPredefinedFunctionBody
methods.description: Retrieves the body of a predefined function by name.

methods.name: getDefaultDatasource
methods.description: Creates and returns a default Datasource object, optionally configured with form properties.

methods.name: getDefaultAlarmDataKeys
methods.description: Returns default alarm DataKeys, initializing them if necessary.

methods.name: defaultAlarmFieldContent
methods.description: Formats alarm field values for display, applying translations and date formatting.

methods.name: processWidgetException
methods.description: Processes exceptions related to widgets, formats messages, and posts messages if in widget edit mode.

methods.name: parseException
methods.description: Parses an exception object into a standardized ExceptionData format.

methods.name: customTranslation
methods.description: Performs translation of strings with support for custom translation prefixes and placeholders.

methods.name: doTranslate
methods.description: Helper method to perform translation with optional prefix.

methods.name: guid
methods.description: Generates a new GUID string.

methods.name: getMaterialColor
methods.description: Returns a material color value based on an index.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Creates a DataKey object from provided KeyInfo and type, assigning colors and other properties.

methods.name: createLabelFromDatasource
methods.description: Creates a label string based on a datasource and pattern.

methods.name: generateColors
methods.description: Assigns colors to DataKeys in datasources if not already set.

methods.name: stringToHslColor
methods.description: Converts a string to an HSL color string based on hash code.

methods.name: currentPerfTime
methods.description: Returns the current high-resolution performance time or Date.now() as fallback.

methods.name: getQueryParam
methods.description: Retrieves a URL query parameter value by name.

methods.name: removeQueryParams
methods.description: Removes specified query parameters from the current URL.

methods.name: updateQueryParam
methods.description: Updates or adds a query parameter in the current URL.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL.

methods.name: deepClone
methods.description: Performs a deep clone of an object, optionally ignoring specified fields.

methods.name: isUndefined
methods.description: Checks if a value is undefined.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Checks if a value is defined.

methods.name: isDefinedAndNotNull
methods.description: Checks if a value is defined and not null.

methods.name: defaultValue
methods.description: Returns the value if defined and not null, otherwise returns a default value.

methods.name: subscribeToEntityTelemetry
methods.description: Subscribes to telemetry data for a given entity and returns an observable of attribute data.

methods.name: objToBase64
methods.description: Serializes an object to a Base64 string.

methods.name: base64toString
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string to a regular string.

methods.name: objToBase64URI
methods.description: Serializes an object to a Base64 URI string.

methods.name: base64toObj
methods.description: Deserializes a Base64 string back into an object.

methods.name: applyCssToElement
methods.description: Applies CSS styles to an element by creating a style element with a unique class.

methods.name: clearCssElement
methods.description: Removes CSS styles and class from an element.
